item.title: University says trans-identified instructor who flunked Christian student no longer has teaching duties
item.description: The University of Oklahoma has announced that a trans-identified graduate assistant who gave a Christian student a failing grade for writing an assignment that criticized gender ideology no longer has teaching duties. #UniversityofOklahoma #Fulnecky #Curth #transgender #gender #academicfreedom

item.title: Pope Leo urged to push for release of Armenian political prisoners in Azerbaijan
item.description: A group of Catholic and Armenian Apostolic leaders is urging Pope Leo XIV to appeal for the release of at least 23 Artsakh-Armenian prisoners held in Azerbaijan, citing their deteriorating condition and the destruction of Christian heritage in Nagorno-Karabakh. #Catholic #ArmenianApostolicChurch #PopeLeoXIV #ArmenianPrisoners #Azerbaijan #ChristianHeritage #NagornoKarabakh #CardinalTimothyDolan #ArchbishopAnoushavanTanielian

item.title: Indian state passes hate crime law church leaders hope will better protect to Christians, minorities
item.description: India's Karnataka state has approved a new law aimed at curbing hate speech and hate crimes, a move welcomed by church leaders and human rights advocates who say it offers stronger protection for religious minorities, including Christians. #India #hatecrime #Christianpersecution #Karnataka

item.title: Democrat-led states sue HHS over push to defund hospitals that perform sex-change procedures on minors
item.description: Nineteen Democrat-led states and the District of Columbia have sued the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services over a series of proposed regulatory actions that would effectively bar hospitals that participate in Medicare and Medicaid programs from performing body-mutilating sex-change procedures on minors. #HHS #LGBT #transgender #NewYork #lawsuit #defunding #hospitals

item.title: StubHub apologizes after listing Christian concert about Jesus as a heavy metal show
item.description: A major online ticket reseller has apologized after mistakenly listing a Christian concert about the life of Jesus as a heavy metal concert. #LambofGod #AndrewPeterson #Christianmusic #StubHub

item.title: Candlelight, carols and chalk blessings shape Christmas across Eastern Europe
item.description: Receiving a chalk blessing at the doorway or decorating wooden boats instead of Christmas trees may seem unfamiliar to many outside the region. Yet across Eastern and Central Europe, Christmas is still marked by traditions shaped by faith, memory and shared life — customs that quietly anchor the season in meaning and community. #Christmas #Romania #Europe #Greece

item.title: Nigerian Christian sentenced to death by hanging granted full pardon after pressure from US lawmaker
item.description: A Nigerian Christian farmer who was sentenced to death after killing a Fulani radical in self-defense following an attack on his farm has been released from prison after Adamawa state Gov. Ahmadu Umaru Fintiri issued a full pardon following pressure from a U.S. congressman. #SundayJackson #Nigeria #Christian

item.title: California can't allow schools to hide gender identity of kids from their parents, judge rules
item.description: California public schools cannot deny parents information about the preferred gender identity of their children, a United States district court has ruled. #California #transgender #education #genderidentity #parentalrights #schools #teachers

item.title: 7 movies families can watch together this Christmas break
item.description: From biblical epics and Nativity reenactments to romantic comedies and holiday dramas rooted in faith and family, here are seven releases to watch this Christmas break. #Christmasmovie #faithbasedfilm #Christmasfilm #familyfilm

item.title: 43 critically missing children rescued in time for Christmas
item.description: A multi-agency operation led to the recovery of over 40 critically missing children who were at risk of violence, sexual exploitation, substance abuse, domestic violence or criminal exposure, but will now be home safe in time for Christmas. #USMarshalsService #OperationNorthernLights #lawenforcement #missingchildren #exploitation
